_format: Each answer is "Canonical | alias | alias = seed". The seed is how many imaginary divers gave that answer — big = common = shallow, 0 = nobody = full 100 points. See README.md.
_pool: Daily dives, Unlimited and Puffer Party only draw from these SEC / Aggie-engineering prompts. Everything else is reachable only through its themed pack.
_apart: Prompts in the same group never share a dive.
